text: そこらへんを　すこし　ブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！

structure.jp: ブラブラ　してくると
structure.en: if you go wander and come back

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.span: してくると　よろしー
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus と and いい means 'you should do it'; よろしー is a stretched よろしい, a formal word for いい. してくると　よろしー = 'you should go do it and come back'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says you go off, do it, and come back. ブラブラ　してくる = 'go for a wander and come back'.

patterns.name: 〜を (through)
patterns.explanation: を with a word about moving shows the place you move around in. そこらへんを = 'around this area'.
